content_metadata.description: A video featuring newly elected representatives from the Ballinasloe Municipal District, Tim Broderick and Aisling Dolan, discussing their newly acquired roles and plans for their term.

activities.description: Tim Broderick introduces himself and Aisling Dolan.
Aisling Dolan expresses her delight and introduces the Ballinasloe Municipal District.
